_schema.description: Pre-built actuators for legged robots. Use with --actuator-mode catalog. Specs reflect joint-side (post-gearbox) properties. Add custom entries by appending to the `actuators` array; only `name`, `peak_torque`, `peak_speed`, `mass`, `cost` are required, the others have sensible defaults.

units.Kt: N*m/A (motor torque constant, joint-side after gearbox if known; optional)
units.ratio: [-] (gear ratio; optional, used for power model fallback)
units.length: m (axial thickness / housing length along the rotation axis; datasheet-sourced where noted, otherwise defaults to 0.6 * width per actuator.py's loader)

actuators.name: Unitree-A1
actuators.notes: Unitree A1/Go1-class quasi-direct-drive motor. torque/speed/mass confirmed vs unitree.com; length is an UNVERIFIED estimate (no published diameter/length found), scaled from comparable QDD actuators. "(M107)" removed from the name -- M107 is a different, larger Unitree motor (107mm dia, 360 N*m, H1 knee), not this one.

actuators.name: Unitree-B1
actuators.notes: UNVERIFIED: real B1 User Manual lists knee peak torque as 210 N*m, not 360 -- this entry's numbers (incl. 0.110 width) more closely match Unitree's M107 motor (107mm dia, 360 N*m, used in the H1 humanoid's knee) or the B2 quadruped, not B1's own joint motor. length=0.074 is borrowed from M107's spec for the same reason -- flagged low-confidence, needs a real B1-specific source.

actuators.name: MIT-Cheetah-3
actuators.notes: T-Motor U8 + 6:1 planetary; Katz 2018 MIT Mini-Cheetah actuator.

actuators.name: TMotor-AK80-6
actuators.notes: CubeMars AK80-6 QDD; lower ratio = faster joint.

actuators.name: ANYdrive-3
actuators.notes: ANYbotics ANYdrive 3 (Harmonic-drive based, ANYmal C robot).

actuators.name: HEBI-X8-16
actuators.notes: HEBI X8-16 series-elastic actuator (very high ratio, slow). torque/mass confirmed vs docs.hebi.us datasheet (110x73x45mm housing, length=45mm sourced from that 3rd dimension); UNVERIFIED: peak_speed here (7.5 rad/s) is ~5x the datasheet's real max (15 RPM = 1.57 rad/s).

actuators.name: ODrive-D5065-DD
actuators.notes: ODrive direct-drive (no gearbox); D5065 motor. R confirmed vs ODrive forum measurements; length is an UNVERIFIED estimate from analogous "5065"-class BLDC outrunners -- no ODrive-specific dimensional datasheet found.

actuators.name: MAB-MD80
actuators.notes: UNVERIFIED: no real MAB product found matching this specific torque/ratio/mass combo. MD80 is actually MAB's controller board, commonly paired with a CubeMars AK80-6 (Ø98x38.5mm, 12 N*m peak, 6:1, 485g) -- length borrowed from that pairing as the closest real analog, but low-confidence given the underlying spec mismatch.

actuators.name: Bota-Roboticer-50
actuators.notes: UNVERIFIED / LIKELY FABRICATED: no real product found under this name -- Bota Systems makes force/torque sensors, not actuators, and no "Roboticer" product exists. All fields here (incl. width) are synthetic, not datasheet-derived. No length added -- see actuator.py's 0.6*width fallback default rather than inventing an unsourced number.
